Writes text at the text cursor like [Print](Print), but without starting a new line, so the next Write or Print continues behind it.

```blitzbasic
;media still fonts/write.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
Cls
Write "One, "
Write "two, "
Write "three"
Print "!"
Print "A new line."
WaitKey
```

![Write](media/fonts/write.png)
@param string  The text to write.
@gap Without a graphics window the text goes to the console instead.
